LIN-PKG-SECUPDATES.title: Pending security updates
LIN-PKG-SECUPDATES.semantics: FAIL: >=1 pending security update in the package cache; WARN: non-security updates pending only; PASS: none. Reads cache only (apt-get -s / dnf -C), never refreshes.

LIN-PKG-AUTOUPDATE.title: Automatic security updates
LIN-PKG-AUTOUPDATE.semantics: PASS: unattended-upgrades / dnf-automatic enabled; WARN: not configured.

LIN-REBOOT-REQUIRED.title: Reboot pending for updates
LIN-REBOOT-REQUIRED.semantics: WARN: /var/run/reboot-required present (patched kernel/libs not loaded); PASS: absent.

LIN-SYSCTL-PTRACE.title: Yama ptrace scope
LIN-SYSCTL-PTRACE.semantics: WARN: kernel.yama.ptrace_scope=0; PASS: >=1; NA: Yama absent.

LIN-SYSCTL-USERNS.title: Unprivileged user namespaces
LIN-SYSCTL-USERNS.semantics: WARN: unprivileged userns creation allowed (unprivileged_userns_clone=1 / max_user_namespaces>0) and not AppArmor-restricted; PASS: disabled or apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1.

LIN-SYSCTL-PROTLINKS.title: Protected symlinks/hardlinks
LIN-SYSCTL-PROTLINKS.semantics: WARN: fs.protected_symlinks or fs.protected_hardlinks =0; PASS: both 1.

LIN-SYSCTL-IPFWD.title: IPv4 forwarding
LIN-SYSCTL-IPFWD.semantics: WARN: net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 (host routes traffic; pivot aid); PASS: 0.

LIN-LSM-MAC.title: Mandatory access control
LIN-LSM-MAC.semantics: PASS: SELinux enforcing or AppArmor enabled; WARN: SELinux permissive/disabled and no AppArmor.

LIN-FIREWALL.title: Host firewall
LIN-FIREWALL.semantics: PASS: ufw/firewalld/nftables/iptables service active or ufw ENABLED=yes; WARN: none active; ERR: cannot determine.

LIN-SSH-ROOTLOGIN.title: SSH root login
LIN-SSH-ROOTLOGIN.semantics: FAIL: PermitRootLogin yes; PASS: no / prohibit-password / forced-commands-only / default; NA: no sshd_config.

LIN-SSH-PASSAUTH.title: SSH password authentication
LIN-SSH-PASSAUTH.semantics: WARN: PasswordAuthentication yes (explicit or default); PASS: no; NA: no sshd_config.

LIN-SSH-EMPTYPW.title: SSH empty passwords
LIN-SSH-EMPTYPW.semantics: FAIL: PermitEmptyPasswords yes; PASS: no/default; NA: no sshd_config.

LIN-SSH-X11.title: SSH X11 forwarding
LIN-SSH-X11.semantics: WARN: X11Forwarding yes; PASS: no/default; NA: no sshd_config.

LIN-SSH-MAXAUTH.title: SSH MaxAuthTries
LIN-SSH-MAXAUTH.semantics: WARN: MaxAuthTries >4 (default 6); PASS: <=4; NA: no sshd_config.

LIN-SSH-CIPHERS.title: SSH weak ciphers/MACs/KEX
LIN-SSH-CIPHERS.semantics: WARN: configured Ciphers/MACs/KexAlgorithms include cbc, arcfour, 3des, md5, sha1 KEX or group1; PASS: none configured weak (default set); NA: no sshd_config.

LIN-SSH-HOSTKEY-PERMS.title: SSH host private key permissions
LIN-SSH-HOSTKEY-PERMS.semantics: FAIL: an /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key is group/world readable or readable by the current non-root user; PASS: otherwise; NA: no host keys.

LIN-ACCT-UID0.title: Extra UID 0 accounts
LIN-ACCT-UID0.semantics: FAIL: any account other than root has UID 0; PASS: only root.

LIN-ACCT-EMPTYPW.title: Accounts with empty password
LIN-ACCT-EMPTYPW.semantics: FAIL: /etc/shadow has an empty password field; PASS: none; ERR: shadow not readable (needs root).

LIN-ACCT-NOPASSWD.title: sudo NOPASSWD rules
LIN-ACCT-NOPASSWD.semantics: WARN: >=1 NOPASSWD rule in sudoers/sudoers.d; PASS: none; ERR: sudoers unreadable (needs root); NA: sudo absent.

LIN-ACCT-UMASK.title: Default umask
LIN-ACCT-UMASK.semantics: WARN: login.defs UMASK grants group/other write (e.g. 002, 000); PASS: 022/027/077.

LIN-ACCT-AGING.title: Password maximum age
LIN-ACCT-AGING.semantics: WARN: login.defs PASS_MAX_DAYS unset or >365; PASS: <=365.

LIN-FILE-SHADOW.title: /etc/shadow permissions
LIN-FILE-SHADOW.semantics: FAIL: /etc/shadow (or gshadow) world-readable or world-writable; PASS: otherwise.

LIN-FILE-PASSWD.title: /etc/passwd permissions
LIN-FILE-PASSWD.semantics: FAIL: /etc/passwd or /etc/group writable by group/other; PASS: otherwise.

LIN-MNT-TMP.title: /tmp mount options
LIN-MNT-TMP.semantics: WARN: /tmp not a separate mount, or mounted without nosuid/nodev; PASS: separate mount with nosuid,nodev.

LIN-MNT-SHM.title: /dev/shm mount options
LIN-MNT-SHM.semantics: WARN: /dev/shm mounted without noexec or nosuid; PASS: noexec,nosuid.

LIN-PATH-WW.title: World-writable directories in PATH
LIN-PATH-WW.semantics: FAIL: a directory on PATH (or /etc/environment PATH) is world-writable without sticky bit; PASS: none.

LIN-CRON-PERMS.title: Cron configuration permissions
LIN-CRON-PERMS.semantics: FAIL: /etc/crontab or an /etc/cron.* entry is world-writable; PASS: none.

LIN-LOG-AUDITD.title: Audit daemon
LIN-LOG-AUDITD.semantics: PASS: auditd active; WARN: not active.

LIN-LOG-SYSLOG.title: System logging
LIN-LOG-SYSLOG.semantics: PASS: rsyslog/syslog-ng active or journald persistent storage; WARN: only volatile journal.

LIN-TIME-SYNC.title: Time synchronization
LIN-TIME-SYNC.semantics: PASS: chronyd/systemd-timesyncd/ntpd active; WARN: none (breaks Kerberos and log correlation).

LIN-BOOT-SECUREBOOT.title: UEFI Secure Boot
LIN-BOOT-SECUREBOOT.semantics: PASS: Secure Boot enabled; WARN: UEFI with Secure Boot disabled; INFO: legacy BIOS boot.

LIN-CTR-DOCKERSOCK.title: Docker socket exposure
LIN-CTR-DOCKERSOCK.semantics: FAIL: /var/run/docker.sock world-writable or writable by the current non-root user; PASS: present and restricted; NA: absent.

LIN-AD-JOINED.title: Directory membership
LIN-AD-JOINED.semantics: INFO: realm/sssd/winbind membership and realm name, or not joined.

LIN-AD-KEYTAB.title: Host keytab readability
LIN-AD-KEYTAB.semantics: FAIL: /etc/krb5.keytab readable by the current non-root user or world-readable; PASS: present and restricted; NA: absent.
